// diagnostic L0537

Jet.FailureMarkUnused

This `?` marks a site that cannot fail.

What

This `?` marks a site that cannot fail.

Why

A bare `?` indicates a typed failure can propagate from that site; leaving it on an infallible site misleads readers.

Fix

Remove the unnecessary `?` (or run `jet fmt` to clean up stale marks automatically).

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.FailureMarkUnused: Tests/UI/failure_mark_unused.stderr.

Warning: Jet.FailureMarkUnused: this `?` is unnecessary because this expression cannot fail
  --> Tests/UI/failure_mark_unused.jet:6:19
    |
  6 |     pure_len(text)? + 1
    |                   ^
 Why: A bare `?` marks a failure propagation; leaving it on an infallible call, loop, or selector misleads readers
 Fix: Remove the unnecessary `?`
